native_constraints.after_enter_world: first-entry branch only, never generic handoff-ready
native_constraints.quest_or_special_packets: only under verified matching native conditions
native_constraints.local_500ms_timers: local callbacks, not a network acknowledgement

handoff.before_commit: reserve target, freeze source, keep source authoritative until durable decision
handoff.commit: record target position/version and unique handoff decision in same role transaction; finalize source once committed
handoff.send_barrier: target connection owner writes and drains the exact ordered SRoleEnterScene for this committed transfer, then emits an immutable server-side barrier event with role/epoch/connection generation/transfer ID/target version
handoff.activation: target map owner verifies the barrier against the committed transfer and may release loading state; this is server delivery activation, not proof of client loading or visible pixels
handoff.failure_before_commit: cancel reservation and thaw source via matching cancellation receipt
handoff.failure_after_commit: retain committed target as sole durable authority; close failed connection and recover target on next valid login; never roll back an already committed handoff solely for a send timeout
handoff.retries: matching receipt is idempotent; stale/foreign transfer barrier rejected

input_guards.same_read_batch: tag decoded input with ingress batch/version; discard remaining gameplay intents from the pre-transfer batch and queued old-version intents
input_guards.loading: reject gameplay writes until matching server send barrier; first-world ACK does not release ordinary loading
input_guards.post_barrier: attach server current map/position version to newly admitted commands; validate expected start position, bounded continuous movement and target-map collision/speed rules where verified
input_guards.npc: entity key, map instance, position version and distance must match new map; old NPC tickets invalidated
input_guards.protocol_limit: the native movement wire lacks a scene-generation token. Transport barrier alone cannot identify every delayed byte; observationally identical old/new requests cannot be perfectly distinguished. Do not claim complete native acknowledgement or universal stale-packet detection
input_guards.unsupported_validation: record remaining collision/speed gaps explicitly; do not label bounds-only movement as fully cheat-resistant

acceptance: no source and target simultaneous authority after commit
old batch intents and old epoch/transfer/version barriers refused
movement stays blocked before exact send barrier, continues after matching barrier
send failure after commit reconnects at durable target without reward or position rollback
continuous native encrypted scene packet decode preserved
actual native client can cross and keep walking; separately inspect visual loading
